scripts.dev: node scripts/run-with-local-supabase-env.mjs npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/run-with-local-supabase-env.mjs npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.start:backend:local: node scripts/run-with-local-supabase-env.mjs npm run start --workspace backend
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.test: npm test --workspace frontend -- --run && npm test --workspace backend -- --run
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
